verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents API tokens for its JMAP API, and a hands-on community report shows its app passwords can be restricted to a single protocol (SMTP-only), which is a least-privilege credential. The evidence pack has only the title of the API tokens article, so per-token scopes (e.g. read-only or mail-only access for an agent) are not actually documented. missing for 10: documented per-scope or read-only options for API tokens, details on token restriction and revocation, independent corroboration that agent-specific scoped tokens work.
